def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    rem = bins - item
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    valid = rem >= 0
    if not np.any(valid):
        return scores
    
    max_cap = np.max(bins) if len(bins) > 0 and np.max(bins) > 0 else 1.0
    
    # Sigmoid-scaled exponential fit score favoring tighter packing
    fill_fraction = 1.0 - (rem / max_cap)
    fit_score = 10.0 / (1.0 + np.exp(-6.0 * (fill_fraction - 0.5)))
    
    # Penalty for intermediate awkward gaps (around 0.25 relative size)
    rel_rem = rem / max_cap
    gap_penalty = 3.0 * np.exp(-(((rel_rem - 0.25) / 0.1) ** 2))
    
    scores[valid] = fit_score[valid] - gap_penalty[valid]
    
    # Tiered penalty for opening new bins
    is_empty = (bins == max_cap) & valid
    if np.any(is_empty):
        first_empty = np.argmax(is_empty)
        non_empty_valid = ~is_empty & valid
        max_non_empty = np.max(scores[non_empty_valid]) if np.any(non_empty_valid) else 0.0
        scores[first_empty] = max_non_empty - 1.0
        
    return scores

    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)

    tightness = 1.0 - (rem / max_cap)

    scores[valid] = base_score[valid]
    
    is_empty = (bins == max_cap) & valid
    if np.any(is_empty):

        # Dynamic penalty for opening a new bin based on item size proportion
        item_ratio = item / max_cap
        empty_penalty = 2.0 + (1.0 - item_ratio)
        scores[first_empty] = max_ne - empty_penalty
    return scores

    rem = bins - item
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    valid = rem >= 0
    if not np.any(valid):
        return scores
    max_cap = np.max(bins) if len(bins) > 0 and np.max(bins) > 0 else 1.0
    empty_mask = (bins == max_cap) & valid
    tight_mask = valid & ~empty_mask
    if np.any(tight_mask):
        scores[tight_mask] = 1.0 / (rem[tight_mask] + 1e-7)
    if np.any(empty_mask):
        first_empty = np.argmax(empty_mask)
        scores[:] = -np.inf
        scores[first_empty] = np.max(scores[tight_mask]) * 2.0 if np.any(tight_mask) else 1000.0
    return scores
